faq.title: Before you dive in
faq.q1: Do I have to give the bot Administrator?
faq.a1: No. The bot needs only Manage Channels, Manage Roles, View Channels, Send Messages and Manage Messages. Nothing more.
faq.a2: No. Ohnivo never deletes existing channels or roles without a second explicit confirmation. You can build next to your structure or merge into it.
faq.q3: What if I don't like the proposal?
faq.a3: Edit it in the preview, regenerate, or send another instruction. Edits and graphics spend credits; generation comes with your plan.
faq.a4: Credits pay for edits and graphics. They arrive with a subscription or a top-up, never expire, and every movement is in the ledger.
faq.a5: Yes. The web app has a Czech/English switch and the bot sends welcomes in the server language.
faq.a6: A standalone Docker service that talks to the web app through a Supabase queue. The web runs on Vercel, the bot does not.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.s1b: Discord ID, username, display name, avatar and the list of servers you manage. We also store server blueprints, build progress, credit balance and payment history.
privacy.s2b: To recognise you at login, verify guild permissions, show your blueprints and builds, and charge credits correctly. We never sell any of it.
privacy.s3b: Discord access tokens are encrypted with a symmetric key and stored server-side only. They never reach the browser. Sessions use an httpOnly cookie and can be revoked by signing out.
privacy.s4b: We send your community description to the AI provider only to generate a blueprint. We never send your Discord token or payment details. Without an AI key the app runs a deterministic demo mode.
privacy.s5b: You can request an export, correction or deletion of your data. Email support and we will respond. Some records (such as the accounting ledger) must be retained by law.
privacy.s6b: We only use technical cookies for login and language preference. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.s1b: Ohnivo turns your description into a Discord server blueprint and, after you confirm it, lets the bot create it. Ohnivo is not affiliated with Discord beyond the standard OAuth login and bot installation.
terms.s2b: You sign in with Discord. We only work with servers where you have Manage Server. You are responsible for the server content and for who you give access to.
terms.s3b: Blueprint generation uses the monthly quota of your subscription. Credits are spent only on refinements, regeneration and graphics according to the published pricing. Building the server is free. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Unused credits stay on your account. Prices include VAT.
terms.s4b: AI output can contain mistakes. Always review the preview before starting a build. The bot never deletes existing channels or roles without explicit confirmation. The service is provided as is.
terms.s5b: You can cancel a subscription in the customer portal at any time. AI access ends at the end of the paid period. You can request account deletion by email.

ready.subtitle: Review the summary and start the build. You can cancel until the last moment.

ready.freeNote: Building is free for any draft, regardless of plan.
ready.faqTitle: What if I don't like it?
ready.faq1a: Yes. Cancel during the countdown. Once started, the job runs to completion. In replace mode, the old structure is deleted only after the new one is built successfully.
ready.faq2q: Will I lose my current server?
ready.faq2a: Not in add mode. After a second confirmation, replace mode deletes existing channels (including messages) and manageable roles with their assignments. This cannot be undone. @everyone, managed roles and roles above the bot remain.
ready.modeTitle: How to handle the existing structure
ready.modeReplaceBody: The new structure is built first. Existing channels and manageable roles are deleted only after the build succeeds.
ready.modeAppendBody: The existing structure stays. New roles, categories and channels are added alongside it, even with the same names.
ready.modeHint: Replace requires a second confirmation by typing DELETE. @everyone and managed roles are preserved.
ready.replaceConfirmBody: After the new structure is built, existing channels (including messages) and manageable roles (including assignments) will be deleted. Deleted content cannot be restored. If building fails, the old structure stays.
ready.stepsNote: After starting you will see a live checklist. The bot builds roles, categories and channels, sets permissions and posts the welcome; replace mode then removes the old structure.
ready.botMissing: The bot is not on the server. The build cannot start without it.

roleGuide.step2: Drag Ohnivo above the highlighted roles, all the way to the top if you like.
